intro.text: The agency that employs Kilahito's painters, hundreds of them in that city alone. Foreman Sukishi has his office at its Kilahito headquarters.
The government agency of Nagadan charged with protecting the public from nightmares, through its painters and the Dreamwatch.

description.text: Painters are grouped into departments, each with its own shift. A foreman runs the painters of each area: he records the nightmares they meet, disciplines those who neglect their duties and calls in the Dreamwatch.

items.text: Once the nightmares stopped coming, the Nightmare Division was disbanded, and the Dreamwatch with it.
